# The only skips a supported-matrix cell may report, one per line: test id | cells | reason.
# A skip not listed here fails the run: a test that did not run proves no row.
DeclineFunctionalTest.a Gradle older than 8_14 gets a named decline, runs every test, and captures nothing | */9.8.0/* | drives its own older Gradle, so the 8.14 cells run it once
TestJvmRangeFunctionalTest.test JVM on JDK 25 | */8.14/* | Gradle before 9.1 does not support Java 25
ClassFileCeilingCharacterizationTest.a change to a module JaCoCo cannot instrument runs the test in another module that executes it | */8.14/* | Gradle before 9.1 does not support Java 25
GeneratedClasspathFilesFunctionalTest.a generated resource read in another letter case runs the test that reads it | linux/*/* | Linux file systems tell letter cases apart, so no other letter case reaches the file
TestJvmRangeFunctionalTest.test JVM on the newest early-access JDK | */*/* | run by the early-access workflow, which fails if it skips there
JvmSharedFunctionalTest.a test that uses SQLite without extensions narrows as on any reviewed library | windows/*/* | only the Linux and macOS builds of SQLite's native library were reviewed
JvmSharedFunctionalTest.a SQLite connection that enables extension loading selects every later test in its JVM | windows/*/* | only the Linux and macOS builds of SQLite's native library were reviewed
JvmSharedFunctionalTest.SQLite at a version nobody reviewed selects every later test in its JVM | windows/*/* | only the Linux and macOS builds of SQLite's native library were reviewed
JvmSharedFunctionalTest.netty-tcnative's BoringSSL build at the reviewed version, told by its bytes, narrows | windows/*/* | only the Linux and macOS builds of netty-tcnative were reviewed
JvmSharedFunctionalTest.netty-tcnative's BoringSSL build at a version nobody reviewed selects every later test | windows/*/* | only the Linux and macOS builds of netty-tcnative were reviewed
JvmSharedFunctionalTest.a test that uses Gradle's native-platform and file events narrows as on any reviewed library | windows/*/* | only the Linux and macOS builds of native-platform and file events were reviewed
